Container.Name: torsher
Container.Overview: Your home cinema in one container: a TV showcase with a catalog, your own library, playback while the file downloads, and series that follow themselves. Self-hosted and open source, built for the TV first.[br][br]Open the WebUI to create the owner account and run the setup wizard. Bring your own Torznab indexer, for example Prowlarr or Jackett; nothing is included.[br][br]The database lives in appdata; downloads and the library share a single Storage path, so kept files can be hard-linked instead of copied.[br][br]GPU transcoding: for Intel or AMD add a Device /dev/dri, for NVIDIA install the Nvidia Driver plugin, then add --runtime=nvidia to Extra Parameters. Details: https://github.com/torsher-app/unraid-templates#gpu-transcoding[br][br]Documentation: https://torsher.app/docs/
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: torrent streaming showcase library catalog tv series

Config.Name: Peer port (TCP)
Config.Description: Incoming connections from torrent peers. Keep it equal to the Peer port variable.

Config.Name: Peer port (UDP)
Config.Description: Incoming connections from torrent peers. Keep it equal to the Peer port variable.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Database, keys, the log and backups. Keep it on a pool, not on a share mounted from another machine. Tip: keep the appdata share on a pool only (an exclusive share), or use /mnt/cache/appdata/torsher, so the database does not go through the user-share file system.

Config.Name: Storage
Config.Description: Downloads (/storage/torrents) and the library (/storage/library). Keep both in this one path: separate paths turn hard links into copies.

Config.Name: Existing media
Config.Description: Optional. Your existing movies and series, read-only. Add them in the panel under Library.

Config.Name: Peer port
Config.Description: Port the torrent engine listens on. Must match both peer port mappings.

Config.Name: Downloads folder
Config.Description: Default downloads folder inside the container. Keep both under /storage so hard links work between downloads and the library. A folder chosen in Settings → Storage takes precedence.

Config.Name: Library folder
Config.Description: Default library folder inside the container. Keep both under /storage so hard links work between downloads and the library. A folder chosen in Settings → Storage takes precedence.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Owner of the files Torsher writes. 99 is nobody on Unraid.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group of the files Torsher writes. 100 is users on Unraid.

Config.Name: TORSHER_SECRET
Config.Description: Optional. Key that encrypts saved secrets in the database. Without it a key file is created in appdata: keep it with your backups.

Config.Name: TMDB_ACCESS_TOKEN
Config.Description: Optional. Your own TMDB API Read Access Token instead of the app key built into the image.

Config.Name: TRUST_PROXY
Config.Description: Only behind a reverse proxy: its address or subnet, so sign-in limits see real client addresses. Leave empty without a proxy.
